parsed.explanation: No criminalisation; constitutional equality plus a 2024 hate-crimes statute explicitly covering gender identity; crucially, the rule of law demonstrably works FOR trans people — a Nov 2025 Equality Court order compelling gender-affirming care and identity-congruent treatment in custody shows protections enforced, and an assault arrest followed the Dec 2024 tavern attack. Offsetting negatives: documented disproportionate violence against Black trans/gender-nonconforming people in townships, historically negligent police handling of killings, a trans woman mocked and denied help at a police station, and mismatched-document exposure to humiliation and fraud-arrest threats. Facility access lacks a documented protective ruling; care access is urban/concentrated. This is Reduced Risk — functioning protections with real, documented friction and violence, well above the 0.55 tier but below the 0.75/0.85 examples where visitor-facing enforcement and acceptance are more uniformly documented.
